name: Online Retail
description: The Online Retail dataset contains 541,909 transnational transactional records for a UK-based registered non-store online retailer between 01/12/2010 and 09/12/2011. The company mainly sells unique all-occasion gifts, and many customers are wholesalers, widely used for customer segmentation and association rule mining.
